title: PATCH /api/projects/:id/milestones/:mid — update milestone
description: Update milestone fields: name, description, due date, status. Does not handle completion (separate endpoint TASK-36).
acceptanceCriteria: PATCH requires auth and project ownership
Accepts partial body: { name?, description?, dueDate?, status? }
Returns 404 if milestone not found for this project

steps.details: 1) getOwnedProject. 2) Find milestone by id WHERE project_id = projectId. 3) Validate body. 4) Update milestone fields. 5) Return 200.
Update milestone name — verify change. Try with wrong milestone id for project — expect 404.
